definitions.explanation: A premium brand of wagyu beef from cattle raised to strict standards in Hyogo Prefecture, whose capital is Kobe. Prized worldwide for its intense marbling and tenderness, and one of Japan's most famous branded beefs.

{神戸牛|こうべぎゅう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{名乗|なの}る→名乗る：11874_nanoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{兵庫県|ひょうごけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}て→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧られた{但馬牛|たじまうし}のうち、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たした→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧ものだけが⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: To be called Kobe beef, only cattle from among Tajima cattle raised in Hyogo Prefecture that meet strict standards are selected.

notes:
{神戸牛|こうべぎゅう} is a premium brand of ⟦{和牛|わぎゅう}→和牛：27668_wagyuu⟧ from cattle raised to strict standards in ⟦{兵庫|ひょうご}→兵庫：27450_hyougo⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧, whose capital is ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧.

USAGE:
Only meat from {但馬牛|たじまうし} (Tajima cattle) that meets rigorous criteria for weight, marbling grade, and place of birth and raising may legally be labeled {神戸牛|こうべぎゅう}; much of the beef sold as 'Kobe beef' outside Japan does not meet this standard.
